svg.title: Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization
svg.desc: The complete Math-RLVR and IF-RLVR verifier panels and the continual optimization heading are visible from the first frame. The remaining overview unfolds in order: continual optimization plots, looking back, token connections, sampling probabilities, and base-policy support shifting first toward IF-RLVR and then Math-RLVR.
